correctness.rationale: Actual graph distances are 1/3 between opposite sides, 2 for distinct same-side and 0 at a selected landmark. Multiset signatures are thus determined by landmark membership, the side cardinalities p,q, and cumulative suffix R_i/prefix S_j. Injectivity on selected and unselected vertices yields p<=q+1, n-p<=q+1, q<=p+1, n-q<=p+1, implying size>=n-1. Odd equality forces same count on cross sides with matching remaining multiplicities. For even equality the cumulative-count blocks must all be two-point alternating pairs, forcing two complementary bases. For odd optimal size the unique singleton count block and no-repeat conditions force exactly one switch (indexed c,d with 0<=d<c<=m); the side automorphism doubles the m(m+1)/2 choices. Independent BFS distance/multiset subset enumeration confirmed n=2..6 and base counts 2,6,2,12,2; package verifier covers n2..9, but is not a substitute for all-n proof.

value.rationale: The half graph is the canonical twin-free chain/Ferrers graph; determining all minimum unordered-distance landmark sets and exact parity-sensitive base multiplicities is a natural complete extremizer classification, unavailable from scalar ordinary/edge/strong metric dimensions.
residual_risks: Value is confined to explicitly stated theorem scope and neither journal-level impact nor downstream use is asserted.

final_claim: For canonical half graphs H_n with a_i adjacent to b_j iff i<=j, the multiset dimension is n-1 when n even and n when n odd; all minimum bases consist of exactly two specified alternating sets when n even, and exactly m(m+1) specified one-switch families and involutive images when n=2m-1.
